biggest_catch: Election Day runs 5:30am to about 8:30pm (15 hours) and no shifts or half days are offered.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is ~15 hours with no half-day shifts.
Pay is 'about $200' and varies by position (not a guaranteed fixed rate).
Must be a US citizen and registered voter in Delaware County.
ALL poll workers must complete training before each election.
Paid by check ~3 weeks after the election.

c1.evidence: Delaware County OH Board of Elections official site (vote.delawarecountyohio.gov) — Election Workers page.

c2.evidence: 'Most poll workers earn about $200 depending on the position they work.'

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: US citizen; registered voter in Delaware County; 18+ (17-year-old high school students may serve as Student Election Officials); training before each election.
notes: Field Tech/Rover positions also listed with separate application; mileage reimbursed if assigned away from home polling location.
numeric_basis: payout from official BOE FAQ ('about $200 depending on position'); time: official Election Day 5:30am-8:30pm (900 min) + mandatory pre-election training (duration unstated, est 120-180 min)
payout_quote: Q: Will I be paid to be a poll worker? A: Yes! Most poll workers earn about $200 depending on the position they work. Election Day starts at 5:30 AM and lasts until about 8:30 PM... Delaware County requires ALL poll workers to train before each election. Training, Election Day, and any extras are all paid together.
payout_value_note: Official BOE FAQ states 'about $200 depending on the position they work' — flat day rate.

s6.note: Steps concrete: contact staffing coordinators, apply, train, serve Election Day.

steps: Contact a Delaware County BOE staffing coordinator (Ali M. Solove (R) 740-833-2085 or Molly Meyers (D) 740-833-2983) or apply via the site.
Complete required training before the election (required of ALL poll workers before each election).
Serve the full Election Day, 5:30am to about 8:30pm (no half-day shifts).
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; training before each election.
